meaning: Dimension-derived decoded RGBA equivalents, counted once per resident image asset ID under the same 24 campaign launch plans and successful two-scene transition model as NATIVE-RESIDENCY-BUDGET.json. NOT actual browser, process, compositor or GPU/VRAM memory measurement.

inputs.scope: 12 missions x 2 weapons; actual productionLaunchPlan + deterministic launchWorld; original plan ID selection independently reproduced

tacticalPortraitCatalog.explanation: Tactical/codex portraits retain 24 compact static IDs (72 MiB total). Drawing a boss portrait never requests the action atlas. One optional selected HD image adds 8 MiB. Hero preloads include one packed action atlas, packed walk/run and idle. A paused committed scene may also remain resident.

ordinaryCombat.explanation: Launch preloads selected mission midboss and final boss, fixed enemy roster, environment and selected hero. Repeated instances share the same atlas record.

bossCombat.explanation: Both boss action atlases are already resident. Selecting animation frame ranges does not allocate another native sprite sheet.

optionalPortraitOverlayOnLargestSteady.explanation: Largest committed campaign plan plus every compact portrait and one HD image.

optionalPortraitOverlayDuringLargestTran.explanation: Previous+new campaign plans plus every compact portrait and one HD image before commit eviction.

atlasStorageComparison.meaning: Catalog total includes retained old models/portraits and new action entries; it is not a launch preload total. Compressed PNG bytes and decoded RGBA are separate.

cancelledLaunchQualification.explanation: Failed/cancelled loads retain the old scene and can leave already fetched candidate images cached until successful commit. Repeated distinct cancellations can exceed the two-plan union. The following is an all-24-campaign-plan union plus compact portraits and one HD image, not measured peak.

exclusions: Non-native/UI/title/equipment images, floor materials, VFX, canvas backing stores, metadata/contour JS objects, decode work buffers, compositor/GPU texture copies, mipmaps, browser cache and driver overhead are excluded.
Legacy procedural rubble/hydrant/trash/sign and patrol-car selection gaps are unchanged and consume no registered native sprite image allocation.
No browser-process or GPU/VRAM peak was measured. Dimension-derived RGBA reduction alone does not prove frame-rate or real-device stability.
